 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz Ethan Banares, Calix Esguerra evicted from 'Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0' 
 By GMA News Published November 14, 2026 7:11pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: PBB Ethan Banares and Calix Esguerra have been evicted from “Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0.”
 In the first eviction of the season on Saturday, results showed that Ethan and Calix got the lowest percentage of votes to save with 28.7% and 1.6% respectively.
 The other nominees, Primo Alterado, Mikee Quintos, Nicole Fortuna, and Nathan Garcia, were marked safe.
 During the first nominations , Calix received 15 points during the nomination, while Ethan received 12 and Primo received 11 points. Nicole got three points, Nathan got two, and Mikee got one point.

 Anthony Constantino also received one point, but Raheel Bhyria was called in to break the tie with Mikee and he chose to save his fellow actor.
 Raheel and Shea Valerio were safe from nomination after winning the Ligtask challenge.
 “PBB: Collab 3.0" premiered on October 24. Sixteen housemates, composed of celebrity personalities, social media stars, and ordinary netizens, entered the new PBB house.
 The series airs on GMA Network from Mondays to Fridays at 9:35 p.m., Saturdays at 6:15 p.m., and Sundays at 4:45 p.m. —Jade Veronique Yap/JCB, GMA News
